title: 4D-STEM-in-SEM: User-Friendly Powder Electron Diffractometer
content: This contribution introduces 4D-STEM/PNBD (four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy/powder nanobeam diffraction) and recent developments in this method, which transforms a scanning electron microscope (SEM) into a fast, simple, and user-friendly powder electron diffractometer [1, 2]. The only hardware requirement is an SEM equipped with a 2D transmitted electron detector (also known as 2D-array STEM or pixelated STEM). The principle of the method is illustrated in Fig. 1.
